title: lgtm-ci results contract v1
description: One normalized result document per runner leg. Every test, coverage and audit runner writes results/<runner>/<matrix-key>/results.json in this shape; renderers (PR comment, step summary, Pages) and required-check verdicts read only this document. v1 may add optional properties; it never removes or retypes one (docs/workflow-contract.md, Results contract).

tool.description: Native tool that produced the counts (pytest, vitest, playwright, cargo-nextest, bats, osv-scanner, ...)

status.description: Leg verdict as seen by the runner. passed: exit 0 and no failed count; failed: a failed count or a non-zero exit; no-tests: exit 0 and nothing ran; error: the native report was missing or unparseable.

counts.description: Test (or finding) counts. Audits report findings under failed and total. total includes xfailed and xpassed when they are present.

xfailed.description: Optional (#1685): expected failures, tests marked to fail that failed (pytest xfail, Playwright test.fail()). Not in passed, failed or skipped; a reader without the field counts 0.

xpassed.description: Optional (#1685): unexpected passes, tests marked to fail that passed without a strict marker. Not in passed, failed or skipped. A strict unexpected pass is a failure and is counted under failed.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the run in whole milliseconds; 0 when the runner does not report one.

coverage.description: Present only when coverage was collected for this leg. Percentages 0-100. A metric the format does not measure (branches in line-only LCOV) is omitted, never 0.

artifacts.description: Files the runner left behind, relative to the job workspace. kind is a short lowercase label (report, coverage, html-report, junit, tap, comment, log).

source.description: Which lgtm-ci runner wrote the document and at which tooling revision.

matrix.description: Matrix coordinate of this leg; key is the matrix field (python-version) and value its value (3.12). Single-leg runners use key "matrix" and value "default".

exit_code.description: Native tool exit code when the runner captured one.

incomplete.description: Present only when a sharded run lost a shard to a cancel or timeout (no completion manifest from GitHub step state), so the counts and coverage cover part of it. Human-readable reason; status is error and renderers show it instead of totals or a coverage percentage.

expected_failures.description: Optional (#1685): the first expected failures with their reasons, in report order, for the comment's collapsed list. At most 50 entries; omitted is how many more the report held. Test ids and reasons are untrusted text (renderers sanitise them).

tap_plan.description: Informational only: present when the TAP streams' result lines differ from their summed 1..N plans, so the counts are approximate. Never changes the status; under kcov the console stream also carries trace output, so it cannot prove a run finished.

expected_failure.description: One expected failure: the test id and the reason the report gives (empty when it gives none). Each is cut to 500 characters, a cut one ending in an ellipsis.
